provenance: Original synthetic English and Bosnian examples authored for BL CLEA by Brzo i Lokalno. No scraped text, private projects or user requests. Existing project terms remain unchanged.
splitPolicy: Each example has a fixed train or heldout assignment. Heldout examples are never used to select vocabulary or update weights.
